title: CallCloud Pricing in 2026: Power Dialer $60, Parallel Dialer $125
summary: CallCloud's Power Dialer is $60 and its Parallel Dialer $125 per seat a month, month to month. See the $40 CallCloud+ add-on, extras, trial and alternatives.
body_markdown:
CallCloud publishes its prices. The Power Dialer is $60 per seat per month and the Parallel Dialer is $125 per seat per month. Both are billed month to month with unlimited US and Canada calling and no seat minimum. The CallCloud+ add-on is $40 more per seat. New accounts get a free trial of three business days. Read on November 17, 2026.


Trellus publishes this guide and sells a competing dialer. This page covers the parallel dialer sold at callcloud.app by CallCloud LLC. An older article on this site, about[CallCloud alternatives for contact centers](https://www.trellus.ai/post/top-11-callcloud-alternatives-for-bpos-contact-centers) , covers a different product of the same name. Every CallCloud detail below comes from CallCloud's own pricing page, product pages and terms of service, opened on November 17, 2026. No price here comes from a review site, and no CallCloud account or trial was used. For a feature-by-feature view, see[Trellus vs. CallCloud](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-callcloud) .


## CallCloud pricing at a glance


CallCloud's[pricing page](https://www.callcloud.app/pricing) lists two plans and one add-on. It says every plan is month to month. It shows no annual price and no annual discount.

The pricing page says the two plans are the same dialer. The Power Dialer calls one number at a time and moves to the next when a call ends or goes unanswered. The Parallel Dialer calls up to five numbers at once. Moving from the Power Dialer to the Parallel Dialer is one click in Settings, and the change is prorated.


## What changes the real cost of CallCloud


The seat price covers most of the bill. A few published extras can add to it.


### The CallCloud+ add-on


CallCloud+ adds $40 per seat per month to either plan. That makes a seat $100 with the Power Dialer or $165 with the Parallel Dialer. The[CallCloud+ page](https://www.callcloud.app/callcloud-plus) describes three parts: Sequences, the Virtual Salesfloor and Practice.


Practice is AI role-play, where reps call AI prospects and get a score. Its minutes are unlimited. The pricing page says the call score on real calls is included on both plans without the add-on.


### Phone numbers


Each seat includes one local number. Extra numbers are $2 a month each. A rep who wants eight numbers would pay for seven extra, which is $14 a month.


### Calling outside the US and Canada


Both plans include unlimited calling to the US and Canada. The pricing page says this means no minute cap, no fair-use policy and no overage. UK calling is an add-on: $15 more per seat on the Power Dialer and $25 more per seat on the Parallel Dialer.


The pages read list no price for calling other countries. CallCloud's[terms of service](https://www.callcloud.app/terms) say it may ask for business verification before it turns on calling, phone numbers, international calling or higher usage limits.


### Contract length, renewal and refunds


The terms were last updated on October 27, 2026. They say paid plans are billed per seat, in advance, each month unless an order says otherwise. Prices are in US dollars and do not include taxes.


A subscription renews until it is cancelled. Cancelling takes effect at the end of the current billing period, and access continues until then. Fees already paid are not refunded, including for part of a period or for unused seats.


CallCloud may change prices with at least 30 days' notice. The new price applies from the next renewal after the notice period.


### Worked examples


Ten seats on the Parallel Dialer come to $1,250 a month at list. Adding CallCloud+ to all ten brings that to $1,650. Ten seats on the Power Dialer come to $600 a month, or $1,000 with CallCloud+. Extra numbers, UK calling and taxes would be added to these totals.


## Who CallCloud fits and who it does not


CallCloud describes itself as a parallel dialer for sales reps. Its site lists pages for insurance agencies and for SDR and lead generation agencies. Reps dial in CallCloud's own web dialer, from lists they upload as CSV or Excel files or sync from another tool.


The[integrations page](https://www.callcloud.app/integrations) lists thirteen CRMs and sequencers plus Slack. They include HubSpot, Salesforce, Salesloft, Outreach, Apollo, Pipedrive, Close, Attio and GoHighLevel. Calls, outcomes, notes and recordings are written back after the call.


It fits a team that wants a low published seat price and no annual commitment. It also fits a team that wants to start without a sales call. The[getting started page](https://www.callcloud.app/getting-started) says the trial needs no card.


CallCloud is a weaker fit for a team that wants a discount for paying annually, because none is published. The trial is short at three business days. Teams that call countries other than the US, Canada and the UK should ask for a price first. Power Dialer support is by email, and the SLA comes with the Parallel Dialer.


A team that wants reps to dial from inside the CRM page they already work in should compare how each product is used, not only the price. The[Trellus vs. CallCloud](https://www.trellus.ai/compare/trellus-vs-callcloud) page sets the two workflows side by side.

## Frequently asked questions


### How much does CallCloud cost per user?


CallCloud's pricing page lists the Power Dialer at $60 per seat per month and the Parallel Dialer at $125 per seat per month. Both are month to month with unlimited US and Canada calling and one local number. The CallCloud+ add-on is $40 more per seat. No annual price is published.


### Does CallCloud have a free trial?


Yes. The pricing page says every new account gets a free trial of three business days, and weekends do not count. The trial includes all five lines on either plan. The getting started page says no card is needed. You pick the Power Dialer or the Parallel Dialer when you subscribe.


### Does CallCloud require an annual contract?


No. The pricing page says every plan is month to month. CallCloud's terms say a subscription renews until cancelled and that cancelling takes effect at the end of the current billing period. Fees already paid are not refunded, including for part of a period or for unused seats.


### What does CallCloud+ add, and what does it cost?


CallCloud+ costs $40 per seat per month on top of either plan. It adds sequences with email, LinkedIn and call steps, a Virtual Salesfloor video room with listen, whisper and a leaderboard, and AI practice calls with unlimited minutes. With it, a seat is $100 on the Power Dialer or $165 on the Parallel Dialer.


### Are minutes and phone numbers included in CallCloud plans?


Calling to the US and Canada is unlimited on both plans, and CallCloud says there is no minute cap and no overage. Each seat includes one local number, and extra numbers are $2 a month each. UK calling adds $15 per seat on the Power Dialer or $25 on the Parallel Dialer.


### Which CallCloud alternatives publish their prices?


Trellus lists Power at $99.99 and Power + Parallel at $149.99 per seat a month. On November 11, 2026, WAVV listed $99 and $149 billed monthly, PhoneBurner started at $165 billed monthly or $140 billed annually, and Salesfinity Gold was $299 month to month or $249 billed annually.
